fixture_contract.outcome_on_empty_eos: retain original no-retry and score 0 for adherence

H1.metric: count primary step1024 outputs with adherence_0_to_3 >=2

H2.metric: count pairs on step1024 where both outputs adherence >=2 and fact-specific actions differ appropriately

adherence_0_to_3.0: Continuation no longer follows central premise, or it directly contradicts the modified fact; empty output/no interpretable continuation also 0
adherence_0_to_3.1: Only isolated prompt entity/object appears or repeated; central goal or changed fact not maintained
adherence_0_to_3.2: Central actor/object and changed fact drive a relevant action, with minor lapse but no direct fact contradiction
adherence_0_to_3.3: Actor, object, changed fact and goal are respected; new continuation advances events plausibly

coherence_0_to_3.1: Some interpretable clauses without connected progression
coherence_0_to_3.3: Coherent progression with linked new events

entity_consistency_0_to_3.2: Mostly consistent actors/referents with minor lapse
entity_consistency_0_to_3.3: Fully consistent actors and object state

causal_continuation_0_to_3.0: Actions contradict cause or no relevant continuation
causal_continuation_0_to_3.1: Weak or implausible response to cause
causal_continuation_0_to_3.3: Clear causal response advances the plot

pair_fact_specific_binary.0: Both outputs may be fluent but at least one does not use its changed fact correctly, or the response is identical generic behavior that ignores the intervention
pair_fact_specific_binary.1: Both continuations pass adherence >=2 and demonstrate appropriate meaningfully distinct responses to their own facts

rubric.cross_rater_agreement: Report raw disagreements; do not invent Cohen kappa from one reviewer

reviewer_contract.reviewer_packet: Hide checkpoint, variant label and pair membership at scoring; show full original prompt and generated continuation to allow adherence scoring
reviewer_contract.source_separation: Reviewer cannot choose model, revise prompt set, see prereg threshold changes, or access unblinding mapping before score file is locked by SHA
reviewer_contract.science_gate: Scorer source/identity must be recorded before inference; a single AI reviewer yields exploratory scoped claim only and is not a human independent rating
reviewer_contract.unblind_after_scores: The two 16-output checkpoint sets are scored before revealing checkpoint labels, variant IDs or pairing; decoded text remains byte-identical to model output
